notes.title: New game, "Teacher Certification Hell" will be available on May 9
notes.content:
Hello, I'm sorry this is not about the Elearning Development Intern. The good news is that at least with the development of the game Teacher Certification Hell, I've got the achievement system and json things all figured out, so there will be at least an achievement system in the next Elearning Development Intern update (Sorry that the localization is still hard for me for this game, the Eng ver of Elearning Development Intern is still long away.)

As for the new game, it was originally intended to be a video diary game and a game about "big problem", but this game got in the way. On the one hand, some systems need to use this relatively simple game to learn. On the other hand, I actually want to take the Teacher Certification Text in the second half of the year, so I need this game to improve my daily exam knowledge experience LoL.

This is a game about teacher certification, in which the real questions of Subject 1 (comprehensive quality) and subject 2 (Educational Knowledge and ability) of the teacher certification exam in recent years are added. The main part of the game is to answer the questions in the way of "PASSING the door which represent the correct answer". Of course, I added some extra functions to make this a little more like a game. 

As one game producer said "Take the Teacher Certification Text and you'll fail and get nothing; But play Teacher Certification-related game on Steam, at least you can get achievements "ːlunar2019crylaughingpigː

Aha just kidding

The new game will be released on May 9, 2023. Welcome to play
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2391040/]Teacher Certification Hell on Steam, Come Hell and get your certification![/url]

notes.title: 价格已更新，打折再买哦
notes.content:
Hello大家好，我是昊。

正如去年年末的公告所说，今年会涨一次价格。嗯，刚刚就涨了。（偷袭！啪！）。这次涨价主要是对19年的定价做了一次调整，从10元的基数调整到了15元。另外我关注到steam的推荐定价里会有一些定价远低于国区的地区定价，也都一个个按照昨晚的汇率进行了调整，确保现在国区价格是所有区域里最低的（当然，如果发生了汇率变化，导致有区域的价格又低于国区，抱歉！）

因为涨价后会有1个月的“不许折扣期”，所以我们下次折扣会发生在2月14日左右，然后是春季促销，然后是3月下旬等等。（平台上4季促销之外的折扣，每次折扣结束和下一次折扣开始之间有30天的冷却，大家可以自行计算或关注我的微信公众号：终身学习者昊 了解相关信息）

如果小伙伴是在北京时间2023年1月11日17点之后以原价购买的，你可以先退费等一下折扣？后面的每次折扣都会打八折（折掉20%），这就意味着折扣的时候再买可以省下一袋方便面的钱哦~~

另外画一下大饼吧，虽然现在我在着手做第二款游戏、第三款游戏，但仍然也在思考还可以往这款游戏里加入哪些新的内容。不过只有一个人，所以游戏的更新大概会在年中？（下次更新会加入成就系统、更多的学习选项和优化几张图——没错，我觉得我的画工越来越厉害了ːlunar2019deadpanpigː）

那么，愿望单加起来吧！

notes.title: 新品折扣期快结束啦，明年还要涨价，大家想玩的快入手哦！
notes.content:
Hello大家好~

（太长不看版）游戏会在明年涨价，所以2022年任何时候的价格都会低于它之后的价格，入手吧！

（正式版）游戏会在明年涨价，所以现在的折扣期价格和首发结束后的价格将会是这款游戏后续生命周期的最低价（之所以加限定条件，还不是因为19年的时候抢先发行折掉了40%......不过现在的游戏质量远远高过19年的版本了）。

为什么涨价呢，其实原因太多了，
[list]
[*]比如这款游戏付出了很多心血
[*]比如吃了一把开心果发现这比我的游戏还值钱！！！
[*]再比如有小粉丝回信说他的[strike]黑心老师[/strike]善良帅气又大方的老师（毕竟也是我的玩家嘛）上一对一让他刷我的游戏里的刷题会玩，而一节课要收他500（这里再重复一下，未成年人请不要玩游戏！虽然我未成年的时候也玩且没有耽误我的学习。专家，呵。）
[*]再比如说不准哪天我把市面上售价1999的垃圾课程也在游戏以分享的名义搞个更精彩的呢（瞧，他又在画大饼了）
[/list]
所以，打算在这款游戏本就不高的热度结束后来一个小幅涨价。
那么，大家快来买吧！

ps，我看了一眼我的基金，哪怕游戏价格涨一点点就可以追上这几年的涨幅了，心塞。

notes.title: 22年11月26日快速更新10之添加了信息弹窗
notes.content:
hello大家~几个小时前更新的时候，我完全没有预料到今天会失眠。
于是......索性就爬起来继续测试信息提示的功能了。

这个功能是因为一位友情测试的小伙伴，她说“你这些按钮按着都没有反应啊！”
我说“你没看上面的时间和精力/精神条在变化么？！？！”
“没有！”

于是我觉得确实应该来个简单的提示，告诉大家这里没有bug，以及简单说明一下在游戏中的休息时光，选择不同的休息选项（看书，看剧，刷短视频，打游戏，健身等等）有什么样的效果。

总之，这个上线了，虽然ui风格保持了本作一贯的风格——丑/简陋
祝大家游玩愉快！（下次更新就只剩小游戏说明了，以及我在研究成就系统。）

notes.title: I, 2022, after 3 years, finally do it again!
notes.content:
I've been thinking about how to improve the game since the first version was released in April 2019, and I've done some design work along the way. But never developed those ideas. It was not until June 2022 that I started the project again, resetting the game flow and main gameplay, recording some in-game videos, and finding various materials for the game. Finally, now something to play with! (Of course, some of the content hasn't been implemented yet). But I can't wait for everyone to try it out!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34658086/8c47a6e98bede38f66f7c3148f67f7d4ea9ebe84.png[/img]
The main contents of the current version include:

[list]
[*] A teaching and research intern experience from early April to the end of June
[*] The change in values corresponding to all work and rest behaviors
[*] Weekly data processing work, weekly meeting, Friday brushing session
[*] Five outcomes
[*] One NPC to NPC to share (the other 12 will start recording after I optimize the content!)
[/list]



Order of updates for subsequent versions

[list]
[*] Change bugs daily
[*] Optimize content daily
[*] A number of themes shared by NPCS in 12 sessions
[*] Proofreading task, data production task, data analysis task small game
[*] Title compilation task, wisdom education task, test situation analysis task of the small game
[*] O related to three special mechanics of the minigame different from other people
[*] More lunch and lunch options
[*] Richer rest behavior manipulation feedback
[*] Outrageous egg
[*] What do you want
[/list]

Enjoy it please!
